title: Delta
description: Structural diff between the JSM-lane and Steam-lane normalized streams for one mechanic slice. Each entry names a divergence: an event present in one lane but absent/different in the other.

jsm_run.description: Relative path to the JSM-lane run directory (e.g. 'runs/20260602T145517Z-phase2-jsm-quickwins')

steam_run.description: Relative path to the Steam-lane run directory

entries.description: List of per-event or per-press divergences, in timeline order

jsm_value.description: JSM-side value (count, duration, rel_total, or null if absent)

steam_value.description: Steam-side value (count, duration, rel_total, or null if absent)

note.description: Optional human-readable explanation of this entry
